observations.why: The speaker enacts a decisional posture — 'we are adopting' performs a binding choice on behalf of the collective, an authority move rather than a proposal or negotiation.
Performance is framed as a proportional cost-benefit ratio — quantified speed advantage over the current setup, the proportionality logic of market-pricing.
The speaker commits the organization to a timeline, enacting authority over when the collective will act — a commissive move that binds the group's future behavior.
